analysis: The PR only adds a test, forwardsDeltaCheckpointRollbackToProviderJob, in provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/Service/LaunchAgentRestartTests.swift (head lines 336-359). It makes no production-code changes and adds no attack surface. The test asserts that SSDPrefixCachePolicy.incrementalCheckpointsFlag is in LaunchAgent.inferencePassthroughEnvKeys and not in WatchdogAgent.passthroughEnvKeys. It also asserts that an unrelated secret is not forwarded into the launchd plist, and that foreground and launchd resolve the same incremental-checkpoint mode for many values. This relates to T-041, the SSD prefix-cache at-rest posture. It pins the allowlist behavior and does not weaken the encryption, HMAC names, TTL or disk-budget mitigations. Remaining integration questions are outside this diff. The real LaunchAgent.inferencePassthroughEnvKeys, SSDPrefixCachePolicy.incrementalCheckpoints and the delta-checkpoint write path are not supplied, so any change to the cache's at-rest artifacts in those files would need a separate T-041 check. Delta complete-checkpoint files should stay within the existing DBK3, HMAC-tag and AAD constraints. The test exercises only environment forwarding, so those at-rest properties are unverified here.
